items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 25 June 2026 11:02pm
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Fine, sunny and very hot day, then showers developing overnight, likely heavy with a small risk of thunder.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 18°C and max. air temperature 28°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-4


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

E or SE 10-15 with gusts of 25-30 over the hills and in the west.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers later.


##Comments##

Locally strong winds. Thunder risk being monitored for the overnight period.


##Today##

Showers at first, likely heavy with a small risk of thunder, then becoming dry with sunny intervals in places. Mist and low cloud possibly developing in the south of the island later in the day.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 23°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-5


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SE


##Wind##

E or SE 10-15, veering S or SW 15-25, decreasing 10-20 for a time overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers. Then poor or very poor in any coastal mist and fog. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Occasional strong winds developing. Thunder risk being monitored for the beginning of this period.


##Tomorrow##

Largely cloudy with the risk of some patchy rain at first, then sunny intervals developing, with an area of rain arriving later in the evening and overnight.
